//: The winding_stairs_1 chain's CONTINUATION pool -- every piece the chain attaches after its
entry piece. The entry piece (winding_stairs_bottom_1) is NOT here: it is placed by the
planner from transitions/classic/shaft_bottom, not by a jigsaw, and listing it here would only
make vanilla draw it as a candidate and reject it for having no matching name.
ONE POOL FOR ALL THREE, unlike the stairs_2 chain next door, which splits into segment/ and
top/. That is not a style choice here -- the pool id is baked into the four .nbt files, all of
which point at this one path. It works because vanilla shuffles a pool and takes the first
element carrying a jigsaw whose `name` matches the source's `target`, and the three targets in
The cost is a couple of wasted draws per link. The benefit of the stairs_2 split is that a
misspelled target fails LOUDLY (an empty pool) rather than by silently exhausting candidates;
see backlog #11. Worth revisiting if this chain grows.
NOTE the typo `winding_staris_mid_bottom` above is real and is in the .nbt files -- it is
spelled the same on both sides so it matches, but fix it on both or neither.
The chain is FIXED-LENGTH, not repeating: bottom -> mid_bottom -> mid_top -> top, each link
named for exactly one successor. Nothing here can loop.
